name: Asking a model through one measured path
vision_statement: Every part asks a model through one path: the tier is chosen by measurement and the vendor behind it can change without any part noticing.
opportunities: New models, vendors and prices appear outside the system, so the tier choice and the vendor adapters are improved by what is measured about them and not by what was configured once.
solution_coherence: Model Plumbing is how every part asks a model. Model Tier Chooser picks, per tier, the model that did the most passing work per unit of cost. Vendor Model Caller asks that vendor and steps to the next provider when one fails.
